title: Bin-packing against spreading: the same 64 GPUs of small jobs, and a 4-node gang after them
purpose: Replay the same seeded trace of single-pod 1-, 2- and 4-GPU jobs (64 GPUs) twice, once with the spreading profile and once with the bin-packing profile of the second scheduler, through a queue on the flavor without topology so that only the scheduler decides placement. After each, read the fragmentation and submit a gang of 4 pods with 8 GPUs each.

checks.description: spreading leaves almost no whole free node; bin-packing leaves at least 6 of 16
checks.because: MostAllocated scores the fullest node highest, so small jobs fill few nodes; LeastAllocated puts each on the emptiest node.

checks.description: after spreading the 4-node gang cannot start, and its waiting GPUs are counted as fragmented; after packing it runs
checks.because: The free GPUs are the same in total; only their arrangement decides whether an 8-GPU pod fits.

notes: Whole free nodes: spreading 0, packing 8; fragmented share 1.0 vs 0.0.
